title: Figure 14. Infrared Energy Spectra for Mach 3 and Mach 3.5
description: Plot of emitted infrared energy versus wavelength in microns (0 to 20) comparing two Planck curves: a red solid line for Mach 3 (591 K) and a blue dashed line for Mach 3.5 (739 K), with the Mach 3.5 curve peaking higher and at a shorter wavelength. Captioned "Figure 14. Infrared Energy Spectra for Mach 3 (red line) and Mach 3.5 (blue dashed line)." Text below discusses satellite IR detection of hypersonic aircraft and missile launches.
